jobs.title: Head of Product Security
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Hybrid role - base 3 days on site

At Logitech, our purpose is to extend human potential in work and play.

We do this by designing software-enabled hardware solutions that drive superior performance when gaming and superior productivity while at work, all with maximum comfort, speed and accuracy. We enable creativity when pursuing passions and connectivity so everyone is seen, heard and can contribute in their own unique way.

As a Swiss company focused on innovation and quality, our products are the point of connection between people and the digital world. We harness the transformative power of design to drive innovation and progress throughout our portfolio in order to deliver truly unique and meaningful experiences. With products available in nearly every country and more than 3.5 million items shipped each week, Logitech is dedicated to driving outcomes that are better for people and planet, reducing our environmental impact by leading the industry in designing for sustainability.

The Team and Role:

The Head of Product Security is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and overseeing the comprehensive security strategy for all Logitech products and associated customer-facing services - including Internet of Things (IoT) devices, mobile applications, desktop software, and their related cloud infrastructure and services - throughout their entire lifecycle, ensuring compliance, protecting customer data, and preserving brand trust.

The Head of Product Security leads a dedicated team and a community of product security champions across the globe.

The role is based in Lausanne, and reports to the CISO.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. These are the behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech.
In this role you will have the following responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership & Governance

• Architect and execute a comprehensive product security strategy and roadmap aligned with business growth, reporting on risk posture and program performance to executive leadership.

• Integrate Product Security resilience as a competitive differentiator, actively supporting brand trust, enabling new service-based revenue models, and mitigating P&L exposure from legal and product liability risks.

• Develop and implement product security policies, standards, and guidelines.

• Direct global regulatory compliance strategies for mandatory standards such as the EU CRA and UK PSTI, overseeing gap analysis and remediation across cross-functional teams.

• Lead and mentor a high-performing security team while fostering a proactive, collaborative security culture across the global organization.

Secure Product Lifecycle & Engineering

• Champion "Security by Design" by integrating secure development lifecycle practices into all IoT, mobile, desktop, and cloud infrastructure products and development teams.

• Establish and enforce "Safe AI by Design" principles to ensure that AI models, training data, and deployed agents are protected against manipulation, adversarial attacks, prompt injection, and property theft.

• Ensure mandatory disclosure and reporting requirements, such as vulnerability disclosure processes and security update periods, are publicly and accurately communicated.

• Enforce robust supply chain and manufacturing security standards for Operations teams and third-party partners (JDM/ODM) and suppliers to protect firmware, source code, and production integrity.

• Provide expert security advice, guidance and support to engineering and product teams.

• Ensure product decommissioning to maintain security integrity throughout the entire produ

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Logitech è lo Sweet Spot per le persone che vogliono che le loro azioni abbiano un impatto globale positivo pur avendo la flessibilità di farlo a modo loro.

Ruolo ibrido - base 3 giorni sul posto

A Logitech, il nostro scopo è quello di estendere il potenziale umano nel lavoro e nel gioco.

Lo facciamo progettando soluzioni hardware software-enabled che guidino prestazioni superiori quando il gioco e produttività superiore mentre al lavoro, il tutto con il massimo comfort, velocità e precisione. Consentiamo la creatività quando si persegue passioni e connettività in modo che tutti siano visti, ascoltati e possano contribuire nel loro modo unico.

In quanto azienda svizzera focalizzata sull'innovazione e la qualità, i nostri prodotti sono il punto di connessione tra le persone e il mondo digitale. Sfruttiamo il potere trasformativo del design per guidare l'innovazione e il progresso in tutto il nostro portafoglio al fine di offrire esperienze davvero uniche e significative. Con prodotti disponibili in quasi ogni paese e più di 3,5 milioni di articoli spediti ogni settimana, Logitech è dedicata ai risultati di guida migliori per le persone e il pianeta, riducendo il nostro impatto ambientale leader del settore nella progettazione per la sostenibilità.

La squadra e il ruolo

Il responsabile della sicurezza dei prodotti è responsabile dell'istituzione, del mantenimento e della supervisione della strategia di sicurezza globale per tutti i prodotti Logitech e i servizi connessi rivolti ai clienti - compresi i dispositivi Internet of Things (IoT), le applicazioni mobili, il software desktop e le relative infrastrutture e servizi cloud - per tutto il loro ciclo di vita, garantendo la conformità, la protezione dei dati dei clienti e la tutela della fiducia del marchio.

Il responsabile della sicurezza dei prodotti guida un team dedicato e una comunità di campioni della sicurezza dei prodotti in tutto il mondo.

Il ruolo è basato a Losanna, e riferisce al CISO.

Il tuo contributo

Siate voi stessi. Essere aperti. Rimanere affamati e Humble. 21a. Sfida. Decide e basta. Questi sono i behaviors you.ll bisogno di successo a Logitech.

In questo ruolo avrete le seguenti responsabilità:

Leadership e governance strategiche

- Architettare ed eseguire una strategia globale di sicurezza dei prodotti e una roadmap allineata con la crescita delle imprese, reporting sulla postura dei rischi e performance dei programmi alla leadership esecutiva. - Integrate Product Security resistance as a competitive differenziazioner, supporto attivo alla fiducia del marchio, consentendo nuovi modelli di reddito basati sui servizi, e attenuando l'esposizione P&L dai rischi legali e di responsabilità dei prodotti. - Sviluppare e attuare politiche di sicurezza dei prodotti, standard e linee guida.

- Strategie di conformità normative globali dirette per standard obbligatori come il CRA dell'UE e il PSTI del Regno Unito, che supervisionano l'analisi delle lacune e la bonifica tra team interfunzionali. - Leader e mentore di un team di sicurezza ad alte prestazioni, promuovendo nel contempo una cultura della sicurezza proattiva e collaborativa in tutta l'organizzazione globale.

Ciclo di vita e ingegneria sicuro dei prodotti

- Champion "Sicurezza per il Design" integrando le pratiche di ciclo di vita di sviluppo sicuro in tutti i prodotti e i team di sviluppo dell'infrastruttura IOT, mobile, desktop e cloud. - Stabilire e far rispettare i principi di "Safe AI by Design" per garantire che i modelli, i dati di formazione e gli agenti schierati siano protetti da manipolazioni, attacchi avversi, iniezione rapida e furto di proprietà. - Garantire obblighi di divulgazione e comunicazione, come i processi di divulgazione delle vulnerabilità e i periodi di aggiornamento della sicurezza, siano comunicati pubblicamente e accuratamente.

- Impedire una solida catena di approvvigionamento e standard di sicurezza per i team operativi e i partner terzi (JDM/ODM) e i fornitori per proteggere il firmware, il codice sorgente e l'integrità della produzione. - Fornire consulenza, guida e supporto esperti in materia di sicurezza ai team di ingegneri e prodotti. - Garantire la disattivazione dei prodotti per mantenere l'integrità della sicurezza durante l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Logitech ist der Sweet Spot für Menschen, die wollen, dass ihr Handeln eine positive globale Wirkung hat und gleichzeitig die Flexibilität hat, es auf ihre eigene Weise zu tun.

Hybrid Rolle - Basis 3 Tage vor Ort

Bei Logitech ist es unser Ziel, das menschliche Potenzial in Arbeit und Spiel zu erweitern.

Wir entwickeln softwarefähige Hardwarelösungen, die bei der Arbeit eine überlegene Leistung und Produktivität bei Spielen und überlegenen Leistungen erzielen, die alle mit maximalem Komfort, Geschwindigkeit und Genauigkeit ausgestattet sind. Wir ermöglichen Kreativität bei der Verfolgung von Leidenschaften und Konnektivität, so dass jeder auf seine einzigartige Weise gesehen, gehört und dazu beitragen kann.

Als Schweizer Unternehmen mit Fokus auf Innovation und Qualität sind unsere Produkte der Ausgangspunkt für die Verbindung zwischen Mensch und digitaler Welt. Wir nutzen die transformative Kraft des Designs, um Innovationen und Fortschritt in unserem gesamten Portfolio zu fördern, um wirklich einzigartige und sinnvolle Erfahrungen zu liefern. Mit Produkten in fast jedem Land und mehr als 3,5 Millionen Produkte pro Woche ausgeliefert, ist Logitech für die treibenden Ergebnisse, die besser für Mensch und Planet sind, reduziert unsere Umweltfolgen durch die führende Industrie in der Gestaltung für Nachhaltigkeit.

Team und Rolle

Der Leiter Produktsicherheit ist für die Erstellung, Pflege und Überwachung der umfassenden Sicherheitsstrategie für alle Logitech-Produkte und damit verbundenen kundenorientierten Services - einschließlich Internet of Things (IoT)-Geräten, mobilen Anwendungen, Desktop-Software und deren zugehöriger Cloud-Infrastruktur und -Services - während ihres gesamten Lebenszyklus verantwortlich, um die Einhaltung der Anforderungen sicherzustellen, Kundendaten zu schützen und das Markenvertrauen zu wahren.

Der Leiter Produktsicherheit führt ein engagiertes Team und eine Gemeinschaft von Produktsicherheits-Champions auf der ganzen Welt.

Die Rolle ist in Lausanne angesiedelt und berichtet an die CISO.

Ihr Beitrag

Sei selbst. Sei offen. Bleibe hungrig und demütig. Kollaboriere dich. Herausforderung. Entscheide dich und tu es einfach. Dies sind die Verhaltensweisen, die du für den Erfolg bei Logitech brauchst.

In dieser Rolle haben Sie folgende Aufgaben:

Strategische Führung & Governance

- Erstellen und führen Sie eine umfassende Produktsicherheitsstrategie und Roadmap, die mit dem Geschäftswachstum abgestimmt ist, Berichterstattung über Risikohaltung und Programmleistung an die Führungsspitze. - Integrieren Sie die Produktsicherheitsresistenz als wettbewerbsfähigen Differenzierungs-, aktiv unterstützendes Markenvertrauen, ermöglichen Sie neue servicebasierte Umsatzmodelle und mildern Sie die P&L-Exposition aus rechtlichen und Produkthaftungsrisiken. - Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Produktsicherheitspolitiken, Standards und Richtlinien.

- Direkte globale Rechtsvorschriften für verbindliche Standards wie die EU CRA und UK PSTI, Überwachung von Lückenanalyse und Sanierung in funktionsübergreifenden Teams. - Führen und Mentor ein leistungsstarkes Sicherheitsteam, während die Förderung einer proaktiven, kollaborativen Sicherheitskultur in der gesamten globalen Organisation.

Sichere Produktlebenszyklus & Engineering

- Champion "Security by Design" durch die Integration sicherer Entwicklungslebenszykluspraktiken in alle IoT-, mobile, Desktop- und Cloud-Infrastrukturprodukte und Entwicklungsteams. - Aufbau und Durchsetzung von "Safe AI by Design"-Prinzipien, um sicherzustellen, dass AI-Modelle, Trainingsdaten und eingesetzte Agenten vor Manipulationen, konversarischen Angriffen, prompten Injektionen und Eigentum Diebstahl geschützt sind. - Gewährleistung verbindlicher Offenlegungs- und Berichtspflichten, wie z.B. Vulnerabilitäts-Offenlegungsprozesse und Sicherheitsupdatezeiten, werden öffentlich und akkurat kommuniziert.

- Erweitern Sie robuste Supply Chain und Herstellung Sicherheitsstandards für Operations Teams und Drittpartner (JDM/ODM) und Lieferanten, um Firmware, Quellcode und Produktionsintegrität zu schützen. - Bieten Sie Experten Sicherheitsberatung, Beratung und Unterstützung für Engineering- und Produktteams. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass Produktstillsetzung, um die Sicherheit Integrität während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus zu halten.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Logitech est la Sweet Spot pour les gens qui veulent que leurs actions aient un impact global positif tout en ayant la flexibilité de le faire à leur façon.

Rôle hybride - base 3 jours sur place

Chez Logitech, notre but est d'étendre le potentiel humain dans le travail et le jeu.

Nous le faisons en concevant des solutions matérielles logicielles qui permettent de réaliser des performances supérieures lorsque le jeu et une productivité supérieure au travail, tout cela avec un maximum de confort, de vitesse et de précision. Nous permettons la créativité lorsque nous poursuivons des passions et des connexions afin que tout le monde soit vu, entendu et puisse contribuer à sa façon unique.

En tant qu'entreprise suisse axée sur l'innovation et la qualité, nos produits sont le point de contact entre les gens et le monde numérique. Nous utilisons la puissance transformatrice du design pour stimuler l'innovation et le progrès dans tout notre portefeuille afin de fournir des expériences vraiment uniques et significatives. Avec des produits disponibles dans presque tous les pays et plus de 3,5 millions d'articles expédiés chaque semaine, Logitech se consacre à conduire des résultats qui sont meilleurs pour les gens et la planète, réduisant notre impact environnemental en dirigeant l'industrie dans la conception pour la durabilité.

L'équipe et le rôle

Le responsable de la sécurité des produits est chargé d'établir, de maintenir et de superviser la stratégie de sécurité globale pour tous les produits Logitech et les services associés destinés aux clients - y compris les appareils Internet des objets (IoT), les applications mobiles, les logiciels de bureau et les infrastructures et services infonuagiques connexes - tout au long de leur cycle de vie, en assurant la conformité, en protégeant les données des clients et en préservant la confiance de la marque.

Le chef de la sécurité des produits dirige une équipe dévouée et une communauté de champions de la sécurité des produits à travers le monde.

Le rôle est basé à Lausanne et relève du CISO.

Votre contribution

Soyez vous-même. Soyez ouvert. Restez affamé et Humble. Collaborez. Défi. Décidez et faites juste. Ce sont les comportements que vous, vous aurez besoin de succès à Logitech.

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez les responsabilités suivantes :

Leadership stratégique et gouvernance

- Architecter et exécuter une stratégie et une feuille de route globales de sécurité des produits qui soient conformes à la croissance des entreprises, rendre compte de la posture de risque et du rendement des programmes au leadership exécutif. - Intégrer la résilience en matière de sécurité des produits comme un différenciateur concurrentiel, appuyer activement la confiance de la marque, permettre de nouveaux modèles de revenus fondés sur le service et atténuer l'exposition aux risques liés à la responsabilité en matière de produits et de droits de propriété intellectuelle.

- Diriger et encadrer une équipe de sécurité hautement performante tout en favorisant une culture de sécurité proactive et collaborative dans l'ensemble de l'organisation mondiale.

Cycle de vie et ingénierie des produits sécurisés

- Établir et appliquer des principes « AI par conception » pour s'assurer que les modèles d'IA, les données de formation et les agents déployés sont protégés contre la manipulation, les attaques adversaire, l'injection rapide et le vol de biens. - S'assurer que les exigences de divulgation et de déclaration obligatoires, comme les processus de divulgation de vulnérabilité et les périodes de mise à jour de sécurité, sont communiquées publiquement et avec précision.

- Appliquer des normes de sécurité robustes dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la fabrication pour les équipes d'exploitation et les partenaires tiers (JDM/ODM) et les fournisseurs afin de protéger le firmware, le code source et l'intégrité de la production. - Fournir des conseils, des conseils et un soutien spécialisés en matière de sécurité aux équipes d'ingénierie et de produits.

titleByLocale.fr: Créateur d'expérience utilisateur de produits matériels senior

jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role
Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer
Level: I3
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Working model: Hybrid (2–3 days/week in the office)

We’re looking for a Senior Hardware Product User Experience Designer who thrives in complexity, precision and enjoys turning technical systems into simple, elegant user experiences. You’ll be part of Logitech’s Global User Experience team, supporting both the Gaming and Personal Workspace categories — two of the company’s most dynamic and fast-evolving business groups.

This is a unique hybrid role combining:

• Hardware Product User Experience design on platform topics such as connectivity and product behavior. You will create guidelines to harmonize experiences across products.

• Keyboard layout design , requiring high attention to detail, precision, and strong visual craft.

You are a systems thinker with strong product instincts, equally comfortable designing high-level architecture and crafting pixel-perfect layouts. You care deeply about how things work—not just how they look—and you’re motivated by solving real user problems across hardware and software.

Responsibilities
Product & Platform Experience

• Design end-to-end product experiences across hardware interactions with firmware and software in mind

• Contribute to platform-level UX topics (e.g., connectivity, device behaviors, system interactions)

• Translate complex technical constraints into clear, intuitive user experiences

• Define information architecture and interaction models for complex systems

Keyboard Layout Design

• Own and design complex keyboard layouts across multiple products, operating systems, and regions

• Create precise, production-ready layout files with strong attention to detail

• Ensure consistency across languages, markets, and product lines

• Collaborate closely with hardware, engineering, and localization teams to align on constraints

• Maintain and evolve standards, guidelines, and assets for keyboard layouts

Logitech Design System Contribution

• Contribute to the evolution of the Logitech Design System

• Define and document platform (e.g., Bluetooth Connectivity) and product guidelines (e.g., Webcam guidelines)

• Ensure alignment between design and engineering implementation (design ↔ firmware engineering)

• Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across products and platforms

• Actively contribute to consistency across Logitech product experiences

• Collaborate with design system and platform teams to improve reusability and quality

Key Qualifications
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:
Design & Systems Thinking

• Strong experience designing complex consumer hardware products

• Strong portfolio showcasing hardware design solutions (e.g., consumer electronics, mobile, ergonomic products, etc.)

• Ability to translate product work into reusable guidelines

• Deep understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies

Craft & Execution

• Strong visual and interaction design skills with a high bar for quality and detail

• Excellent understanding of typography, layout and visual hierarchy

• Exceptional attention to detail and ability to deliver production-ready assets

• Understanding of localization challenge, typography, and spatial constraints

Tools & Technical

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator

• Experience with Figma

• 3D application is a plus

Collaboration & Communication

• Experience working closely with engineering and product teams

• Strong storytelling and presentation skills

• Strong in communication with multiple stakeholders and teams

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and fast-paced environments

jobs.title: Machine Learning Training Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Role:
We are seeking an ML Training Infrastructure Engineer to elevate the engineering practices across our Machine Learning and EdgeAI teams and improve their velocity. In this role, you will act as a shared champion of DevOps / MLOps excellence. Your mission is to drive excellent model training by designing the reusable scaffolding (templates, CI/CD pipelines, and data management workflows) that allows our ML engineers to work faster, smarter, and with absolute consistency. A key focus of this role is optimizing training pipelines to fully leverage our High Performance Computing (HPC) infrastructure, ensuring scalability and performance. You are the interface with our Digital Office (who manage core AWS/HPC resources and MLOps infrastructure) and the applied ML teams, ensuring knowledge transfer and engineering best practices are seamlessly integrated.

Your Contribution:
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will look after:

• Infrastructure rollout & onboarding: Lead infrastructure migration and adoption by guiding ML engineers to new shared compute environments, optimizing developer workflows to reduce friction, and providing comprehensive documentation and hands-on training to ensure team upskilling.

• Enablement & Knowledge Transfer: Act as the internal consultant and coach for ML teams for High Performance Computing (HPC) optimization. Run workshops, pair-program on pipeline bottlenecks, and document modern MLOps standards to upskill the engineering org and facilitate knowledge sharing.

• Standardization & Templating: Design and maintain "cookie-cutter" project templates. Ensure any ML engineer can spin up a new repository that is automatically compliant, structured, and integrated with data/artifact versioning.

• CI/CD & Continuous Training (CT): Build and maintain robust automation pipelines. Design the triggers and workflows that automate data validation, model retraining, and evaluation when new data arrives or performance baselines change.

• Compute & Code Optimization: Partner with ML engineers to profile and optimize training pipelines and local/edge inference code in pair work, ensuring high efficiency on local host computers and specialized compute resources.

• Digital Office Liaison: Act as the primary technical point of contact to translate the Digital Office’s AWS policies, high-efficiency compute setups, and infrastructure realities into practical, developer-friendly workflows for the ML teams. You are the product owner of the MLOps toolchain making sure the requirements of the ML team are implemented as tools by the Digital Office.

• AI Governance & Data Stewardship: Establish and enforce frameworks for ethical AI, model transparency (via model cards), and data privacy compliance. Act as the steward of our data ecosystem by aligning processes for data inventory, lifecycle management, and accessibility, ensuring that high-quality, compliant data is readily available for training and inference across all projects.

Key Qualifications:
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

• Education: PhD or MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in MLOps, DevOps, or Software Engineering with a heavy focus on developer tooling, automation, platform enablement and pipeline optimization. Hands-on experience designing, building, or maintaining large-scale ML training infrastructure. You have trained ML models on HPC platforms as part of your prior experience and have been acquainted with the different elements of the stack, from data manage
